ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
Switch(
    Substitute(
        Trim(
            Coalesce(
                gblSelectedWorksheet,
                ""
            )
        ),
        "REG ",
        ""
    ),

    "Accommodations",
        ForAll(
            Filter(
                'Accommodation Data Clone',
                IsBlank(gblSelectedFacility) ||
                FacilityMnem_Source = gblSelectedFacility
            ),
            {
                RecordKey: Text(ECCS_Clone_RowId),
                WorksheetName: "Accommodations",

                SourceFacility: Coalesce(
                    FacilityMnem_Source,
                    ""
                ),
                SourceMnemonic: Coalesce(
                    Accommodation_Mnem_Source,
                    ""
                ),
                SourceName: Coalesce(
                    Accommodation_Name_Source,
                    ""
                ),
                SourcePACode: Coalesce(
                    PA_Code_Source,
                    ""
                ),
                SourceActive: Text(
                    Active_Source
                ),

                TargetFacility: Coalesce(
                    FacilityMnem_Target,
                    ""
                ),
                TargetMnemonic: Coalesce(
                    Accommodation_Mnem_Target,
                    ""
                ),
                TargetName: Coalesce(
                    Accommodation_Name_Target,
                    ""
                ),
                TargetPACode: Coalesce(
                    PA_Code_Target,
                    ""
                ),
                TargetActive: Coalesce(
                    Active_Target_Value,
                    ""
                ),
                TargetMatchMtx: Coalesce(
                    TargetMatchMtx,
                    ""
                ),

                ReadOnly: false
            }
        ),

    "Locations",
        ForAll(
            Filter(
                Locations,
                IsBlank(gblSelectedFacility) ||
                'Source Facility Mnemonic' = gblSelectedFacility
            ),
            {
                RecordKey:
                    Coalesce(
                        'Source Facility Mnemonic',
                        ""
                    ) &
                    "|" &
                    Coalesce(
                        'Source Location Mnemonic',
                        ""
                    ),
                WorksheetName: "Locations",

                SourceFacility: Coalesce(
                    'Source Facility Mnemonic',
                    ""
                ),
                SourceMnemonic: Coalesce(
                    'Source Location Mnemonic',
                    ""
                ),
                SourceName: Coalesce(
                    'Source Location Name',
                    ""
                ),
                SourcePACode: Coalesce(
                    'Source PA Code',
                    ""
                ),
                SourceActive: Coalesce(
                    'Source Location Active',
                    ""
                ),

                TargetFacility: Coalesce(
                    'Target Facility Mnemonic',
                    ""
                ),
                TargetMnemonic: Coalesce(
                    'Target Location Mnemonic',
                    ""
                ),
                TargetName: Coalesce(
                    'Target Location Name',
                    ""
                ),
                TargetPACode: Coalesce(
                    'Target PA Code',
                    ""
                ),
                TargetActive: Coalesce(
                    'Target Location Active',
                    ""
                ),
                TargetMatchMtx: Coalesce(
                    'Target Match Matrix',
                    ""
                ),

                ReadOnly: false
            }
        ),

    FirstN(
        Table(
            {
                RecordKey: "",
                WorksheetName: "",
                SourceFacility: "",
                SourceMnemonic: "",
                SourceName: "",
                SourcePACode: "",
                SourceActive: "",
                TargetFacility: "",
                TargetMnemonic: "",
                TargetName: "",
                TargetPACode: "",
                TargetActive: "",
                TargetMatchMtx: "",
                ReadOnly: true
            }
        ),
        0
    )
)
